# Buildicy — AI Growth Systems & Product Engineering Studio

> Thoughtful AI systems engineered to capture, qualify, and convert leads 24/7. Built around your business.

Buildicy is an AI growth systems and product engineering studio founded in February 2026 by Prajwal N (CEO) and Mayur P (CTO), headquartered in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India, working with clients worldwide.

## Core Systems & Solutions

- **Starter — AI Lead Machine & Funnel**: Captures enquiries in sub-3 seconds across web forms, qualifies buyers using custom scoring rules, syncs directly with Cal.com or Google Calendar, and cuts no-shows below 8%.
- **Growth — 24/7 AI Receptionist & Front Desk**: Answers phone calls and WhatsApp 24/7 with ultra-low latency, answers FAQs, qualifies prospects, books appointments, and triggers instant SMS/WhatsApp triage for dropped or missed calls.
- **Scale — Complete AI Growth Engine**: Full-stack revenue engine featuring omnichannel capture, two-way CRM sync (HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Pipedrive), cold lead reactivation, conversation objection mining, and weekly model tuning.
- **Custom Software & Internal Portals**: Tailored web apps, client CRMs, workflow automations, and proprietary studio infrastructure.

## Delivery & Protocol

- **14-Day Implementation Sprint**: Fixed 14-day guaranteed delivery from architecture audit, custom guardrail training, and telephony integration to staff handover.
- **Client Ownership**: Clients retain 100% ownership of their data, prompts, CRM integrations, and workflows. Zero vendor lock-in.
- **Zero Hallucination Guardrails**: Systems operate strictly on client-approved knowledge bases with real-time human escalation triggers.
